item.title: Edgar Douglas LaFountain
item.description: Edgar LaFountain was a loving husband, and father. He loved spending time with his grandchildren, and great grandchildren. He will be deeply missed by his loved ones. Read more: Edgar Douglas LaFountain

item.title: Ocala driver wins NHRA Gatornationals in record-setting weekend
item.description: Ocala’s own Josh Hart gave a dominant performance at the 2026 Amalie Motor Oil NHRA Gatornationals this past weekend, setting the track speed record and earning his first career pole in route to a victory in his debut with John Force Racing. item.title: Children, Marion driver injured after truck crashes into school bus picking up students
item.description: A Silver Springs commercial truck driver was seriously injured and multiple teenagers sustained minor injuries after the vehicle crashed into the back of a school bus that was stopped to pick up students on Monday morning. item.title: Elia Allonce
item.description: Elia Allonce will be remembered as a devoted and loving family member who cherished her loved ones deeply. Known for her strong sense of discipline and dedication, she lived her life with purpose and integrity. Read more: Elia Allonce

item.title: I suggest vegans eat at home or get salads before telling Raising Cane’s how to operate in Ocala.
item.description: "Heather Moore of Sarasota (representing The PETA Foundation of Norfolk, CA) writes that Raising Cane's needs more vegan options. Stay in your own lane, Heather! Why does every restaurant have to offer “fake meat” to customers? Go get a salad somewhere and join your friends at Raising Cane's while they are enjoying chicken fingers and fries. Give us a break!" - Multiple local residents shared opinions about a recent letter to the editor. Read more: I suggest vegans eat at home or get salads befo
